title: A MESSAGE FROM #THOMAS THE #MARTYR
segments: I am honored to have walked alongside
Jesus of Nazareth as one of his
Apostles it was a time filled with
Miracles teachings and moments of deep
Faith news reached us that Jesus had
risen from the dead but I found it
difficult to believe how could a man who
suffered such a brutal crucifixion and
died on a cross have returned to life
doubt plagued my mind and heart
overshadowing The Joy felt by my fellow
Apostles I yearned to witness the
resurrection for myself not merely rely
on the words of others days later I
found myself among the apostles in a
locked room fearing both the authorities
and the turmoil unfolding Within Me
suddenly Jesus stood Among Us his
resurrected presence washing away my
uncertainty turning towards me he
reached out his hands and said put your
finger here see my hands reach out your
hand and put it into my side stop
doubting and
believe overwhelmed with gratitude and
awe I fell to my knees in worship before
my Lord and Savior Jesus further
comforted me saying because you have
seen me you have believed blessed are
those who have not seen and yet have
believed his words resonated deep within
my soul reminding me that Faith does not
always rely on tangible
proof as the years passed I continued my
Apostolic Journey sharing the teachings
of Jesus with others eager to spread the
message of Hope eventually my path led
me here to India where I would spend the
remainder of my years as a missionary
introducing the gospel to our Brethren
scattered here I accept the gospel will
lead to my martyrdom as you condemn me
for the truth I preach unto you that you
obstain from these dumb
idols
what
